grave-marker.prompt: A plain wooden grave marker set up by a family on its own land in 1836: a rounded-top board of weathered pine, about four feet high, with no words or symbol on it, standing at the head of a low mound of bare earth, a few yellow, white and pink wildflowers laid on the mound and growing at its edge. Quiet and dignified, never frightening; no body, no coffin, no text. Three-quarter view at the scale of the people who stand beside it; warm hand-drawn storybook style, dark olive-brown outline, flat shade, transparent ground.
grave-marker.rasterised: Playwright/Chrome screenshot of the inlined SVG, transparent ground (scripts/build-claude-standins.mjs)

coins-and-paper.prompt: What a family counts at the table after the war: a short stack of silver reales and two loose coins, a folded sheet of paper (a bill of sale) with lines of handwriting too small to read, and a small drawstring leather purse, lying together on a table top. At the scale of a person seated at the table; warm hand-drawn storybook style, dark olive-brown outline, flat shade, transparent ground, no legible text.
coins-and-paper.rasterised: Playwright/Chrome screenshot of the inlined SVG, transparent ground (scripts/build-claude-standins.mjs)
